description: This PHP class 'BasicAuthListener' handles HTTP Basic Authentication for private zones in a web application, intercepting request events to enforce access control based on configuration and session data.

classes.name: BasicAuthListener
classes.description: A listener class that enforces HTTP Basic Authentication on incoming requests for private zones.

methods.name: onRequest
methods.description: Handles the request event, checks for public routes, private zone access, and performs HTTP Basic Authentication if needed.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this listener subscribes to, specifically the Kernel request event.
